# AponiaJS

> A structured TypeScript framework for Bun and Elysia: modules, dependency injection, decorated HTTP routes, validation, enhancers, WebSockets, agent tooling, and a publishable library contract.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): the quick start, CLI commands, and framework capabilities.
- [Learning path](docs/learn/README.md): the ordered introduction.
- [Architecture and style](docs/architecture-and-style.md): the application and framework layout.
- [Agent surface](docs/agent/README.md): `aponia manifest`, `aponia mcp`, the read-only tools, and the gated write/verify tools.
- [Libraries](docs/libraries.md): authoring, checking, and publishing a library.
- [Published packages](docs/packages.md): the npm catalog.

## Contracts

- `aponia manifest` prints the guarded framework contract.
- `aponia.library.json` states a library's entrypoint, provided tokens, framework compatibility, and security posture.
- Every published package ships its own `llms.txt`.

## Security

- The agent surface is read-only by default; `--allow-write` and `--allow-exec` gate mutation, and library paths stay confined to the workspace.
- CSRF, security headers, sessions, rate limiting, and SSRF-safe HTTP ship as opt-in packages.
- The HTTP client blocks private, loopback, link-local, and metadata addresses unless explicitly opted out.
